svg.title: Undergraduate capstone / thesis workflow
svg.desc: The main route covers all 8 stages. Decision nodes state when to continue; side branches show where to return if conditions are not met. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.This is a guide to the work involved. Learning, research and writing may overlap. Formal approval, recognition of outputs and degree conferral follow the rules applicable to you and your institution's decisions.

text.tspan: The main route covers all 8 stages. Decision nodes state when to continue; side branches show where to return if conditions
